files.legend.sop:
@legend.session.things core.legend
    namespace=session.things
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    doc="The things of the session and what the user taught. State: things (id, kind, name, attrs, origin, shown, aspects), views (declarations, cached), learned (wires of the knowledge format as text), person (the person of the session: w.person facts kept by src/dialog/person.mjs, spec 23 section 12; null until the user says something about themselves)."

files.operations.sop:
@op.session.things.learn core.operation
    impl=learn
    semantics=action
    action=things.learn
    doc="The user teaches a fact in any view (is a kind of, called, can / cannot, lives in, made of): stored as a wire of the knowledge format in the session and read by every view at the knowledge tier."

@op.session.things.sync core.operation
    impl=sync
    semantics=action
    action=things.sync
    doc="A view publishes its things (the whole list) to the session store; the store keeps the identity of each thing across views."

@op.session.things.show core.operation
    impl=show
    semantics=action
    action=things.show
    doc="Select things into a view: the view takes what it has an aspect for and a kind for, and says plainly why it cannot take the rest."

@op.session.things.list core.operation
    impl=list
    semantics=action
    action=things.list
    doc="The things of the session and the views that show them."

@op.session.things.own core.operation
    impl=own
    semantics=action
    action=things.own
    doc="A question about the things the user named (my dog is called Rex): what is my dog called, who is Rex, what pets do I have, do I have a cat. A pet is a thing of the user whose kind the catalog keeps as an animal."

@op.session.things.undo core.operation
    impl=forget
    semantics=action
    action=things.undo
    doc="Undo that / forget that after a lesson: the newest lesson (its wires and the thing of the user it made) is taken back."
files.patterns.sop:
@pat.session.things.kindof core.pattern
    canonical="Remember that a waiter is a kind of person."
    match="[$lang.lead.polite]? [remember|note]? [that]? [a|an|the]? {a:words(3)} [is|are] [a|an]? [kind|type|sort] of [a|an|the]? {b:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=9
    example="A villa is a kind of house."
    example="Remember that a waiter is a kind of person."
    doc="Teach: X is a kind of Y."

@pat.session.things.isa core.pattern
    match="[remember|note]? [that]? [a|an] {a:words(3)} is [a|an] {b:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=8
    example="A villa is a house."
    doc="Teach: a X is a Y (the article marks a kind)."

@pat.session.things.own core.pattern
    match="[remember|note]? [that]? my {a:words(3)} [is|was] [called|named] {n:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=9
    example="My dog is called Rex."
    example="My sister is named Ann."
    doc="Teach: a thing of the user, with its name."

@pat.session.things.have core.pattern
    match="i have [a|an] {a:words(3)} [called|named] {n:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=9
    example="I have a cat called Tom."
    doc="Teach: a thing of the user, with its name."

@pat.session.things.can core.pattern
    match="[remember|note]? [that]? [the|a|an]? {a:words(3)} [can|cannot|cant] {v:words(2)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=7
    example="Ducks can float."
    example="Penguins cannot fly."
    doc="Teach: what a kind can or cannot do."

@pat.session.things.bare core.pattern
    match="[remember|note]? [that]? [the|a|an]? {a:noun} {v:lex.session.things.abilities}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=statement
    priority=11
    example="Ducks float."
    doc="Teach: a bare plural and an ability (seed list, temporary)."

@pat.session.things.live core.pattern
    match="[remember|note]? [that]? [the|a|an]? {a:words(3)} [live|lives|stay|stays|sleep|sleeps] [in|on|at|under|near] [a|an|the]? {b:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=7
    example="Fish live in water."
    doc="Teach: where a kind lives."

@pat.session.things.madeof core.pattern
    match="[remember|note]? [that]? [the|a|an]? {a:words(3)} [is|are] made [of|from] {b:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=8
    example="A boat is made of wood."
    doc="Teach: what a kind is made of."

@pat.session.things.select.session core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.polite|$lang.lead.filler]? [make|create|build|draw|give_me|show_me|show|put_together|write|start|do|generate|prepare]? [me]? [a|an|the]? [nice|new|simple|quick|short|little]? {to:lex.session.things.views} [of|about|from|on|for|with|using|based_on] [$dialogue.session]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.show arg.to=\"{to}\" arg.thing=\"the discussion\""
    kind=request
    signal=true
    priority=14
    example="Create a chart about the current discussion."
    example="Make a document about what we did."
    doc="The session as the content of a view: the whole selection of things (and, for a document, its topics, games and places) goes into the view named, by the one operation things.show."

@pat.session.things.select.did core.pattern
    canonical="Make a chart of what I drew."
    match="[$lang.lead.polite|$lang.lead.filler]? [make|create|build|draw|give_me|show_me|show|put_together|write|start|do|generate|prepare]? [me]? [a|an|the]? [nice|new|simple|quick|short|little]? {to:lex.session.things.views} [of|about|from|on|for|with|using|based_on] [what|everything|all_the_things|all|the_things|things|stuff] [that]? [i|we|you] {v:lex.session.things.did} [so_far]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.show arg.to=\"{to}\" arg.thing=\"what I {v}\""
    kind=request
    signal=true
    priority=14
    example="Make a chart of what I drew."
    example="Create a document about everything we made."
    doc="What the user did in one view (the verb names the view: drew is the drawing) as the content of another view."

@pat.session.things.select.in core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.polite|$lang.lead.filler]? [make|create|build|draw|give_me|show_me|show|put_together|write|start|do|generate|prepare]? [me]? [a|an|the]? [nice|new|simple|quick|short|little]? {to:lex.session.things.views} [of|about|from|on|for|with|using|based_on] [the|all_the|all|my]? [things|stuff|items|objects] [in|on|from|of] [the|my]? {v:words(2)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.show arg.to=\"{to}\" arg.thing=\"things in {v}\""
    kind=request
    signal=true
    priority=14
    example="Make a chart of the things in the plan."
    example="Create a document about the things in the drawing."
    doc="The things one view holds as the content of another view."

@pat.session.things.select.it core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.polite|$lang.lead.filler]? [show|put|place|pin|mark|plot|display|see|send|move|bring|add|find|locate] [me]? [it|that|this|that_one|this_one] [on|in|onto|into|to] [the|my]? {to:lex.session.things.views}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.show arg.to=\"{to}\" arg.thing=\"it\""
    kind=request
    signal=true
    priority=14
    example="Show it on the map."
    doc="The thing last talked about, into the view named, by the one operation things.show."

@pat.session.things.select.places core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.polite|$lang.lead.filler]? [show|put|place|pin|mark|plot|display|see|send|move|bring|add] [me]? [all]? [the|my|all_the|all_my]? {n:words(1)} [that]? [we|i|you] [talked_about|discussed|mentioned|looked_at|saw|asked_about|learned_about|said|covered|talked|spoke_about] [so_far]? [on|in|onto|into|to] [the|my]? {to:lex.session.things.views}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.show arg.to=\"{to}\" arg.thing=\"{n} in the discussion\""
    kind=request
    signal=true
    priority=14
    example="Put the places we talked about on the map."
    doc="The things of the discussion that have one aspect (places are the geographic ones) into the view named; the noun names the aspect, no kind of thing is listed here."

@pat.session.things.count core.pattern
    canonical="A zebra has 4 legs."
    canonical="A rhombus has 4 sides."
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? [a|an|the] {a:words(2)} [has|have|has_got|have_got] {n:number} {p:noun}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="A zebra has 4 legs."
    example="A rhombus has 4 sides."
    doc="Teach a count of a thing (legs, sides, corners): read by type into the catalog slot the counted word means (k.animals.animal legs, k.shapes.shape sides)."

@pat.session.things.count.plural core.pattern
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? {a:lex.session.things.kinds} [have|has] {n:number} {p:noun}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Spiders have 8 legs."
    doc="Teach a count of a kind said with a bare plural the catalog knows."

@pat.session.things.colour core.pattern
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? [a|an|the]? {a:noun} [is|are] {c:lex.session.things.colour}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="A strawberry is red."
    doc="Teach the colour of a thing (k.attributes.thing colour, by type)."

@pat.session.things.colour2 core.pattern
    canonical="Zebras are black and white."
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? [a|an|the]? {a:noun} [is|are] {c:lex.session.things.colour} and {d:lex.session.things.colour}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Zebras are black and white."
    doc="Teach two colours of a thing."

@pat.session.things.mix core.pattern
    canonical="Black and red make brown."
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? {a:lex.session.things.colour} [and|with|plus] {b:lex.session.things.colour} [$lang.teach.make] {r:lex.session.things.colour}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Black and red make brown."
    doc="Teach a colour mix (k.colours.mix a b gives): the lesson wins over the catalog's mix in this session (the taught tier)."

@pat.session.things.eat core.pattern
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? [a|an|the]? {a:noun} [$lang.teach.eat] {f:word}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Zebras eat grass."
    doc="Teach what a kind eats (the slot the verb means: k.animals.animal eats)."

@pat.session.things.eat2 core.pattern
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? [a|an|the]? {a:noun} [$lang.teach.eat] {f:word} and {g:word}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Zebras eat grass and leaves."
    doc="Teach two things a kind eats."

@pat.session.things.say core.pattern
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? [a|an|the]? {a:noun} [$lang.teach.say] {s:word}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Ducks say quack."
    doc="Teach the sound of a kind (k.animals.animal sound)."

@pat.session.things.baby core.pattern
    match="[$lang.teach.lead]? [a|an|the]? [baby|young] {a:noun} [is|are] called [a|an]? {b:word}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.learn arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="A baby zebra is called a foal."
    doc="Teach the name of the young of a kind (k.animals.animal baby)."

@pat.session.things.covered core.pattern

    kind=request
    priority=12

@pat.session.things.own.called core.pattern

    match="[$lang.own.recall]? [what|whats|how] [is|was|are]? my {k:noun} [is]? [$lang.own.called]"

    kind=request

@pat.session.things.own.name core.pattern

    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.own arg.seek=called arg.kind=\"{k}\""

@pat.session.things.own.name2 core.pattern

    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.own arg.seek=called arg.kind=\"{k}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="What's my dog's name?"
    example="My pet name?"
    example="Remind me my pet's name."

@pat.session.things.own.didcall core.pattern
    match="[what|how] [did|do] [i|we] [call|name] my {k:noun} [again]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.own arg.seek=called arg.kind=\"{k}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="What did I call my pet?"
    doc="The name of a thing of the user."

@pat.session.things.own.list core.pattern
    canonical="What pets do I have?"
    match="[what|which] [pets|animals] [do|did] [i|we] have"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.own arg.seek=list"
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="What pets do I have?"
    doc="The pets of the user: the things they named whose kind is an animal."

@pat.session.things.own.exists core.pattern
    canonical="Do I have a dog?"
    match="[do|did] [i|we] have [a|an|any]? {k:noun}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.own arg.seek=exists arg.kind=\"{k}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Do I have a dog?"
    doc="Whether the user told about a thing of that kind."

@pat.session.things.own.who core.pattern
    match="who is {n:agent}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.own arg.seek=kind arg.called=\"{n}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Who is Rex?"
    doc="Which thing of the user has this name (Rex is your dog)."

@pat.session.things.own.what core.pattern
    match="[what|which] [pet|animal|kind_of_pet|kind_of_animal] is {n:agent}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.own arg.seek=kind arg.called=\"{n}\""

@pat.session.things.own.isa core.pattern

@pat.session.things.undo core.pattern
    match="[$lang.undo|forget_that|forget_it|forget_what_i_said|forget_what_i_taught_you]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=things.undo"
    kind=request
    priority=9
    example="Undo that."

    doc="Takes back the newest lesson (only after a lesson: \"undo\" follows the world of the newest step)."
files.world.sop:
@world.session.things core.world
    namespace=session.things
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.session.things
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.lang.common
    imports=world.session.dialogue
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Things of the session"
    summary=""
    doc="A shared module, not a tab (spec 23, TRANSFER): the one store of things of the session (identity, kind from knowledge, attributes grouped in aspects: visual, spatial, relational, numeric, textual, geographic, temporal, social) and what the user taught (session.learned: wires of the knowledge format, overlaid on the catalog for this session by src/knowledge/learned.mjs). A tab is a VIEW: a schema world declares the aspects it shows (acts.view) and gets `view` and `adopt` operations generated; selecting a thing into a view is the one operation things.show. Its patterns read what the user teaches (a villa is a kind of house; my dog is called Rex; ducks float; fish live in water; a zebra has 4 legs; zebras are black and white; a ruler is a rectangle; black and red make brown: a statement is read BY TYPE into a wire of the catalog's own type, which wins over the catalog in this session, the taught tier), the questions about the user's own things (what is my dog called, what pets do I have, do I have a cat, who is Rex) and the undo of the last lesson. It took over what kids.animals and kids.shapes read (plan H3, 2026-11-14). Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."

# Typed needs (sopworld 0.39.0, std.schema.needs): the schemas of the knowledge worlds, so that a lesson is read by type (src/knowledge/teach-typed.mjs).
@need.session.things.slots std.schema.needs
    of=session.things
    type=core.slot
@need.session.things.words std.schema.needs
    of=session.things
    type=core.word
